recipes.title: Copycat Starbucks Spinach Feta Wraps

steps.text: Heat a non-stick skillet over medium-high and spray lightly. Add the egg whites, let them set about a minute, then lift the edges and tilt so the uncooked egg runs underneath. Flip for a crisp top if you like. Slide onto a board and cut into eight pieces.
Wilt the spinach in the same pan over medium heat. Turn off the heat, add the feta and stir; it should soften but not melt.
Spread pesto on each tortilla, top with a piece of egg and the spinach-feta mixture, and roll up burrito-style.

makeAhead.note: assembled wraps keep 1 week in the fridge or 1 month frozen; brown before eating

steps.text: Reheat the skillet over medium and brown the wraps 1 to 2 minutes per side until crispy.

reviewNotes: Source cuts the omelette into four pieces for eight wraps; cut into eight so each wrap gets one piece.
From frozen: microwave 2 minutes wrapped in paper towel, then brown in a skillet.
